title:
Stage 1 forge tier — increment 2a ONLY: surface syntax (REQ-3). Authoritative spec: .design/stage1-forge-tier.md REQ-3 + AC-7; sequencing in .design/stage1-forge-tier-kickoff-plan.md. The foundation (increments 0+1: seven-verdict CertVerdict, schema-v2 certs, axiom-gate hoist, Engine covenant-signature) is already MERGED on main — build on it. Follow the ACToR read-write-verify-commit loop; commit per coherent sub-unit; self-verify before each commit and revert anything that fails. If low on time or budget, STOP at a sub-unit boundary and report what landed; the branch is resumable.

SCOPE: REQ-3 surface syntax ONLY, in thermite-syntax (parser.rs, ast.rs, address.rs, lexer.rs). This ships the PARSE + AST + ADDRESSING + hole-gating surface; the SEMANTIC consumers are later increments and are OUT OF SCOPE here: covenant logic / inhabit / falsify (2b, REQ-4), tactic battery (2c, REQ-5), anti-Goodhart re-elaboration (2d, REQ-6), goal/fill proof view (2e, REQ-7), relax engine (2f, REQ-8b), lemma-library mechanics (3, REQ-9). Do NOT build those consumers; parse the surface and represent it in the AST so they can consume it next.

DELIVERABLES (all always-on, no feature flag; gating is forge-side via holes/routing):
1. New item kinds beside fn in the item parser: prop fn; lemma name(args) req ... ens ... proof { ... }; proof for f { ens#k by { ... } }. Add the AST Item variants; round-trip tests.
2. witness { inhabit (...); falsify N; } blocks: parse into AST nodes (consumed by 2b later — here, parse + represent + round-trip only, NO execution/covenant logic).
3. ?pN proof holes: the lexer learns the p-prefix sigil (?p<digits>) alongside the existing ?<digits> body-hole machinery (TokKind::Hole); add proof-block position/depth tracking; add an AST context field distinguishing body holes from proof holes; address.rs gains proof-block addresses (e.g. f.proof.ens#k and the ?pN form). A ?pN outside a proof block is a STRUCTURED syntax error. An OPEN ?pN blocks build AND certification via the existing open_hole_reason path.
4. Refinement-type sugar x: T{P}: desugar in a NEW post-parse pass (none exists in thermite-syntax today) to req/ens clauses + call-site obligations, so downstream stages (thermite-spec validation, lowering) see ONLY the v1 clause shapes plus the new item kinds.
5. dec lex(...) and dec wf <rel>: ASCII relation spelling per the resolved Q-DECWF (NOT the Unicode angle-bracket form — the lexer stays ASCII-only, no multibyte operator lexing).

GAUNTLET before each commit: cargo test -p thermite-syntax; cargo clippy -p thermite-syntax --all-targets -- -D warnings; cargo fmt --check. AC-7 specifically: all the new surface forms have AST + address round-trip tests; ?pN-outside-proof is a structured error; an open ?pN blocks build and cert through open_hole_reason. Run the full workspace build to confirm no downstream breakage (the desugaring keeps downstream seeing v1 shapes); the conformance oracle must stay byte-identical (no .th in the corpus uses the new syntax yet, so this should be a no-op — verify it).

REGISTRY: this stage now uses the canonical REQ registry. Register REQ-3 in .design/reqs/registry.toml (the foundation registered REQ-S1-* there) and regenerate the status view; run req-registry.py --check clean. Do NOT hand-write a new ## REQ status comment table — the registry is the source of truth now. Where a surface is parsed but its semantic consumer is a later increment (lemma/proof/witness), reflect that honestly in the registry status (e.g. partial with the consuming increment named) rather than claiming a consumer that does not exist.

SCOPE GUARDS: no cage / combinator-menu change (thermite-spec REGISTRY untouched); do NOT flip the README/docs headline (G1 gate only, R-GATE-1); never stage .crosslink/hook-config.json; no stubs/TODOs (parsed-but-not-yet-consumed surface is fine and is not a stub — it has parse/address/round-trip tests as consumers). One branch; open ONE PR for increment 2a.
